summary: Phase 11 Moderation + Admin UI end-to-end frontend testing. Registered a new normal user, verified NO admin nav link and admin-forbidden guard on /admin/moderation. Opened a /shop listing, submitted a report (Counterfeit / fake with note) — success toast shown. Logged in as admin — nav-admin-link visible, /admin/moderation renders heading, stats bar, 7 filter buttons, case list (13 cases). Clicked into a case (status Created) → Start investigation (→ Investigation) → selected 'ListingRemoved' action, entered reason, Record decision (→ DecisionMade with the recorded decision visible under 'Decisions (append-only)') → Close (→ Closed, read-only). All data-testids present and working. Regression: nav-shop-link, nav-messages-link, notification-bell all render; listing PDP shows price + pdp-message-seller-button. All flows successful; only expected 401/403 network responses (pre-login session probe + normal-user probing mod endpoints for forbidden state) — no JS errors.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminModeration.js: Login flow works but the 'Close' button remains rendered after DecisionMade (correct) and disappears in Closed state via the read-only branch — good. Confirmed append-only decisions rendering by decision_id.

ReportButton.js: gated by useAuth (null user hides button) — good. Uses REASONS list matching backend enum expectations. Success toast text 'Report submitted — our team will review it' displays via sonner.
Nav.js: correctly gates data-testid=nav-admin-link on user.role in ['admin','moderator'].
